experiment_template.research_question: Does one-shot recycle-boundary state improve native ContextBench selection while avoiding repeated state input and recycle amplification?
stop_conditions: Any missing or duplicate recycle-boundary presentation.
Any within-round task, source, prompt, cap or threshold change.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells and retains every outcome.

records.falsifier: Any generation receives more than one presentation, any recycled generation receives none, state facts or receipt bindings are invalid, aggregate state-arm tokens do not fall below round nine, valid/file outcomes degrade, or paired native span F1 gain remains below 0.05.
records.mechanism: For each newly selected recycler generation, construct and inject the fitted receipt-bound projection on only the first dispatched request. Record that generation as presented only after the matching model receipt; omit state on later requests until another recycle creates a new generation.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Presenting receipt-bound task state exactly once at each recycle boundary preserves useful continuity while removing repeated state-token input and recycle amplification.

records.research_question: Does one-shot recycle-boundary state improve native ContextBench selection while avoiding repeated state input and recycle amplification?
stop_conditions: Any missing or duplicate recycled-generation presentation, state above 1,024 tokens, more than four fitting measurements, unmatched receipt, false fact, or omitted token is an instrument failure.
Any second incomplete output or correction count above one is an instrument failure.
No acceptance or successor selection change from observed outcomes.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, policy, or ordering change and no lucky rerun.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempted outcome.

success_criteria.scope: Eight exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K one-shot boundary-state pairs; no full cohort, larger window, confirmation, repair correctness, transfer, or clearance claim.

records.claim: One-shot state matched every one of 27 recycle generations without duplicates. Three complete pairs showed +0.2288 mean span F1 and attempted state arms used 57,576 fewer known tokens, but a shared GLM deadline left only 13 attempts, 3 complete pairs, 3 unstarted cells, and one unknown-usage call.
limitations: Complete-case quality and unequal attempted-arm token totals are descriptive only.
Native evidence selection does not establish repair correctness or semantic retention.
One task gained a valid score while another lost one; aggregate valid scored completions tied 4-4.

records.next_action: Preserve the exact one-shot state mechanism, extend the common per-model deadline from two to five minutes, and run a separately versioned frozen replication over all eight exposed pairs. Do not add delta semantics until the promising incomplete signal is resolved.
